start: Routine preview 'Push Day', no workout open

user_sees: The live workout: running clock at the top, each exercise with its sets, 'Add exercise', 'Discard workout', and 'Log a set to finish' (greyed)
must_not: The clock starting from an old time
An empty workout

steps.action: Type kg and reps on the first set and tick it
user_sees: The set ticked; the rest timer starts in the bar at the bottom
'Finish workout' replaces 'Log a set to finish'
must_not: The rest timer not starting
A record pop-up for a set that is not a record

steps.action: Wait for the rest to end
user_sees: 'Rest is over' alert with sound or buzz
must_not: No alert
An alert for a workout already finished

user_sees: Sheet 'Finish workout?' with the overview, the name box, 'How did it go?', 'Finish workout' and 'Keep going'
must_not: The workout saved before the sheet is answered

user_sees: The summary 'Workout complete' replaces the live screen
must_not: The emptied workout ('0m 00s', Add exercise) shown on the way out
Two saved workouts after a double tap

steps.action: Tap the down arrow 'Minimise workout. It keeps running.' (or the phone's back)
user_sees: The Workout tab with a bar above the tabs for the open workout; the clock keeps going
must_not: The workout discarded
The clock paused

steps.action: Tap the bar, or the notification that shows the open workout, or hold the app icon and tap 'Resume workout'
user_sees: The live workout at the exercise the member was on
must_not: The Workout tab instead of the workout
The top of the list, far from the current exercise

user_sees: Back on the workout with both at the end
must_not: Each added twice after a double tap
Two pickers stacked

steps.action: Open an exercise's menu and swap it
user_sees: 'Swap exercise' 'Instead of Bench Press, for this workout only' with 'Swap to'
must_not: The routine itself changed by the swap
Logged sets of the old exercise lost without a word

user_sees: The new exercise in the same place
must_not: A swap error when it worked

start: A saved workout's page, 'More' > 'Edit workout' (or Calendar 'Log a past workout')

steps.action: Change a set and tap 'Save changes' ('Save workout' for a past log)
user_sees: 'EDITING' (or 'PAST WORKOUT') at the top instead of the clock; then the saved workout's page
must_not: A running clock on an old workout
A second copy of the workout

steps.action: Open it again, change a set and press the phone's back
user_sees: 'Discard changes?' 'Your edits will be thrown away. The saved workout stays as it was.' with 'Keep editing'
must_not: The edit left open as a workout in progress

user_sees: 'Log a set to finish' greyed
must_not: A Finish that saves an empty workout

steps.action: Tick a set, open Finish, untick it and finish
user_sees: 'Nothing to save' 'Tick at least one set before finishing.'
must_not: An empty workout saved

user_sees: 'Could not save' 'Something went wrong saving your workout. Your sets are still here — tap Finish to try again.'
must_not: The sets lost
A half-saved workout

steps.action: In an edit, remove every set
user_sees: 'Keep at least one set'
must_not: A saved workout with no sets

user_sees: 'Set removed' with 'Undo' for about 4 seconds
must_not: The set gone with no way back

user_sees: The set back in its place
must_not: The set back in another exercise

user_sees: 'Discard workout?' 'This workout and its sets will be deleted. This cannot be undone.' with 'Keep logging' and 'Discard'
must_not: Discarded without asking

user_sees: The Workout tab, no open-workout bar
must_not: The workout still in history
The bar still showing

start: Live workout, member not signed in

user_sees: The workout saved on this phone only
must_not: Workouts sent to MettleUp or the gym without signing in

steps.action: Sign in and finish another workout while the account space is full
user_sees: 'Your space on MettleUp is full, so new workouts stay on this phone only.'
must_not: The workout lost
A silent failure to copy
